description: This Java source file defines a REST controller 'AnswerController' that provides CRUD endpoints for managing Answer entities related to questions. It uses Spring Boot annotations to map HTTP requests to methods, handles operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting answers, and interacts with AnswerRepository and QuestionRepository for data persistence.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: REST controller managing CRUD operations for Answer entities linked to questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Retrieves all answers associated with a specific question ID.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Creates a new answer for a specified question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Updates an existing answer identified by answer ID for a given question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Deletes an answer by answer ID for a specific question.
